title: Remedy
description: PACK-09, Framework 0.8.1 section 13.1. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.casework.Remedy). The appeal/review route attached to a decision. Framework hard invariant 52 requires that a remedy route exist before a sanction may stand; it does not make that route permanently open, so `available_from`/`available_until` bound it and exercising outside the window is refused with REMEDY_UNAVAILABLE. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
